title: Mildly Golden Apples
description: Useful for curing lots of zombie villagers ⊂(◉‿◉)つ
body: # Mildly Golden Apples - Changes golden apple recipe from gold ingots to nuggets - frees up your gold to use with my other mod. - makes curing lots of zombie villagers more affordable ## Compatibility * has only been tested with 1.20.4 ## Issues [![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49eac7d4916630c1ca7a85fe90f40e2363ae80eb.png)](https://discord.gg/W3T34eVScQ) #### I dont plan on making Forge/NeoForge versions, if any mod devs would like to join my projects to work on these, please contact me on Discord!
